response.sql: WITH item_stats AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, AVG(ili.product_price * 1.0 / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Order_Items oi LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_item_avg_ratios, AVG(line_item_count) AS avg_of_item_line_item_counts FROM item_stats;

assumptions.assumption: A ratio is missing when product_price is NULL or derived_total_cost is NULL or zero (NULLIF turns a zero divisor into NULL); missing ratios are skipped by AVG.
Each order item's line-item count includes every invoice line item linked to it by order_item_id, including those whose ratio is missing; order items with no line items count as zero.
Invoice_Line_Items is joined to Order_Items on order_item_id alone; an order item can appear on several invoices, and all of its line items are included.

alternatives.interpretation: Count only the invoice line items that have a usable ratio (product_price and a nonzero derived_total_cost), so the per-item count matches the ratio average's basis. Order items with no usable line items still count as zero.
alternatives.sql: WITH item_stats AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, AVG(ili.product_price * 1.0 / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(CASE WHEN ili.product_price IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS valid_line_item_count FROM Order_Items oi LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_item_avg_ratios, AVG(valid_line_item_count) AS avg_of_item_valid_line_item_counts FROM item_stats;
